title: Transform each value
summary: F#: Transform each value. Multiply by 3.
introduction: List.map applies a function to every item and returns a new list.

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Transform each value
blocks.code:
let values = [2; 3] |> List.map (fun n -> n * 2)
printfn "%A" values

blocks.text: The anonymous function doubles each item. The pipe passes the list to List.map.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The pipe sends the list into the next function call.
